name: KromiumCookie
declaration: data class KromiumCookie(val name: String, val value: String, val domain: String?, val path: String, val isSecure: Boolean, val isHttpOnly: Boolean, val hasExpires: Boolean, val expires: Date?)
description: Represents a single HTTP cookie in the Kromium engine, capturing name, value, domain, path, security flags (isSecure, isHttpOnly), and expiration date.
whenToUse: Used with KromiumCookieManager to inspect, set, or delete individual HTTP cookies across browser sessions.

properties.name: domain
properties.description: The domain scope of the cookie (e.g. ".example.com"), or null for origin-only.

properties.name: path
properties.description: The URL path scope of the cookie (e.g. "/").

properties.name: isSecure
properties.description: Whether the cookie is restricted to secure HTTPS connections.

properties.name: isHttpOnly
properties.description: Whether the cookie is hidden from document.cookie JavaScript access.

properties.name: hasExpires
properties.description: Whether the cookie specifies a fixed expiration date.

properties.name: expires
properties.description: The expiration timestamp, or null for session cookies.

frameworkExamples.code:
import org.daviante.kromium.api.cookie.KromiumCookie
import java.util.Date

val cookie = KromiumCookie(
    name = "session_id",
    value = "xyz123",
    domain = ".example.com",
    path = "/",
    isSecure = true,
    isHttpOnly = true,
    hasExpires = true,
    expires = Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + 86400000L)
)
